Class Pioche

java.lang.Object
cascadia.board.Pioche
public class Pioche extends Object
Represents the draw pile (Pioche) of tiles and fauna tokens in the Cascadia game. It handles the initialization, drawing, and recycling of tiles and tokens.

    • Pioche

      public Pioche(int nbJoueurs)
      Constructor that initializes the draw pile based on the number of players. Populates the pile with habitat tiles and fauna tokens.
      Parameters:
      nbJoueurs - the number of players in the game. Must be at least 1.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the number of players is less than 1.
